items.title: Heath Info Hut open day
items.summary: The Heath Info Hut Pop by the Heath Info Hut at Parliament Hill for information about Hampstead Heath and what’s coming up. Click here for the location. You can: pick up a free map or nature sheet find out about upcoming events and activities ask questions of our friendly team buy Hampstead Heath-related goodies (e.g. books, cards, bags)

items.title: Litter pick
items.summary: Join us for a Saturday afternoon litter pick. All welcome and all equipment provided. Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.

items.title: Wild about Hampstead Heath
items.summary: Come and find out about nature on our green spaces with our volunteer wildlife interpreters. All welcome, drop in anytime between 1-3pm, no need to book. Look out for the big Wild About Hampstead Heath bike, in the Parliament Hill area.

items.title: Hedgeplanting with Hampstead Heath Eco Club
items.summary: Join us for the second event of our new Youth programme: Hampstead Heath Eco Club . This time, we’ll be planting new hedges around the Parliament Hill area! Join us to find out about the importance of hedges for wildlife and biodiversity and make a real difference by planting your own little trees on Hampstead Heath! This is a youth event , open to children age 10-17 only . Booking is required (click the button below), and we’ll send joining instructions prior to the event. We’ll meet in the Parliament Hill area - further details provided on booking. Book here

items.title: Hampstead Heath Photo Exhibition
items.summary: Join us at The Kenwood Dairy for an exhibition of this year’s top Hampstead Heath photo competition entries. The exhibition will include spectacular photographs of Hampstead Heath, including this year’s winning entry, a beautiful image by Joe Hayman, and the winning under 18s entry, a great shot by Milo Dawes, aged 13. No need to book, stop by between 10am-3pm from the 26th-28th of November. Teas and coffees to warm up also available for a donation, and there’ll be an opportunity to buy the Hampstead Heath Calendar as well as other Heath-related goodies. Milo Dawes - under 18s winner Joe Hayman - adult category winner

items.title: Queen’s Park Trees and Ecology walk
items.summary: Join us for a guided walk of Queen’s Park, looking at trees and their ecological value. The walk will meet outside the Queen’s Park Cafe - further instructions to be provided on booking. All welcome, including children of any age - but anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. The walk is free (donations welcome) but booking is essential. Book here

items.title: Kenwood Dairy open day
items.summary: Come and view our Nature Interpretation Centre to find out more about the wildlife across the Heath’s green spaces. Pick up a leaflet, check out our specimens and find out what’s coming up! Interpretation centre displays.

items.title: Highgate Wood - Tree and fungi walk
items.summary: Enjoy an guided walk of trees and fungi found in Highgate Wood, led by their staff. All guided walks are free to attend with no booking required. They last approximately 1 to 1.5 hours. Meet at the information hut next to the café. For more information and to book click the link below . Learn more

items.title: Gardening Volunteering
items.summary: Join our open volunteering sessions! We’ll be gardening and taking part in light conservation tasks around the Hive area. All ages welcome to join - children under 11 should be accompanied by a responsible adult, children aged 12-17 can be dropped off by an adult. All equipment provided, as well as tea and biscuits! No need to book: you can just turn up or you’re welcome to email us so we have a rough idea of numbers. Please arrive prompty for the session start at 4pm.

items.title: Wreath Making - Kenwood
items.summary: Join us for a workshop on Hampstead Heath to make your own festive wreath from natural materials. This workshop will take place on the Kenwood Estate. Once you’ve booked on (below) we will send you joining details for the workshop, including a detailed meeting point. There is a £25 donation, click below to book your space, to cover our costs for this workshop, which includes: All the materials you will need; Instructions from our friendly team; Hot drinks, Mince pies and other treats and Please note that our wreath-making workshops are outdoors - shelter will be provided in the event of rain, but do dress for the weather! Cancellations: if you can no longer attend, please let us know at least 72H before the event so that we can offer your space to someone else. We will not be able to issue refunds nearer to the workshop date. Are you interested in joining more events? Why not join as a Friend of Heath Hands - individual membership is £40 and includes free access to all our paid-for workshops, additional member-only activities, a monthly newsletter to keep you up-to-date on our activities and discounts in our webshop . Book here

This is a youth event , open to children age 10-17 only . Booking is required (click the button below), and we’ll send joining instructions prior to the event. We’ll meet in the Parliament Hill area - further details provided on booking. Book here
